# Environment

```{r}
# Packages
packages <- c(
  "tidyverse", "ggtext", "cowplot", "ComplexHeatmap",
  "circlize", "grid", "scales"
)

# Load packages
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE))

# Print environment
set.seed(45)
Sys.info()
sessionInfo()

# Themes
source("./lib/consistent_themes.R")

# Shared data
source("./lib/processed_data_functions.R")
```

# Clinical isolate data
```{r}
load_processed_data(
  "./data/NG_probe/curated/pilot_qc_data.RDS",
  c(
    "qcd_data", "probe_data", "reference_coverage_summary"
  )
)
load_processed_data(
  "./data/NG_probe/curated/pre_binning_kraken_data.RDS",
  "pre_binning_kraken_summary"
)

A <- ggplot(
  probe_data,
  aes(x = pool_level, y = enrichment, fill = pool_level)
) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point() +
  ylim(0, NA) +
  pool_fill_scale +
  labs(x = "Pool", y = "Relative abundance fold change") +
  theme_bw_me +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Multi-panel cowplot

```{r, fig.width = 8.75, fig.height = 7}
aligned <- align_plots(
  p_len_panel + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  p_ctg_panel + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  align = "h", axis = "lr"
)

part_e <- plot_grid(aligned[[1]], aligned[[2]], 
                    labels = c("E", "F"), label_x = -0.066, 
                    nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1, 1))

p_cov_heat_cow <- cowplot::plot_grid(p_cov_heat,ncol=1)

row_top <- plot_grid(A,p_stage_lines + theme(legend.position='none'), p_taxonomic_progression,nrow = 1,
                     labels = c("A", "B","C"), rel_widths = c(.5, .75,.5), label_size = 12)

row_bottom <- plot_grid(p_cov_heat_cow, part_e, nrow = 1,
                        labels = c("D", ""), rel_widths = c(1, 1.5), label_size = 12)

qc_cowplot <- plot_grid(row_top, row_bottom, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 1))

qc_cowplot
```

# Save

```{r}
ggsave("./figures/figure_3_pilot_sequencing_clinical_isolates.png", plot = qc_cowplot, width = 8.75, height = 7, units = "in", dpi = 900)
```
